rules.title: Security deposit maximum and payment limits at commencement of tenancy
rules.quote: At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following: (i) rent for the first full month of occupancy; and, (ii) rent for the last full month of occupancy calculated at the same rate as the first month; and, (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2)
rules.summary: At the start of a tenancy, a landlord cannot require more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to one month's rent, and key/lock costs.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Introductory paragraph of clause (b) of subsection (1) as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55 effective August 1, 2025. See 2025, 9, Sec. 136.

related_citations.evidence: Introductory paragraph of clause (b) of subsection (1) as amended by 2025, 9, Secs. 54 and 55 effective August 1, 2025.

rules.coverage_text: Does not apply to leases of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purposes
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to vacation/recreational leases of 100 days or less
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of right to retain security deposit; treble damages equal to three times the security deposit plus 5% interest, court costs and reasonable attorney's fees for certain violations

rules.title: Security deposit interest payment requirement
rules.quote: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.
rules.summary: Landlords holding a security deposit for one year or longer must pay the tenant interest at 5% per year or the lesser amount received from the bank, payable at the end of each year of tenancy.
rules.penalty: Treble damages equal to three times the interest owed plus court costs and reasonable attorney's fees if interest not paid within 30 days of termination

rules.title: Last month's rent interest payment requirement
rules.quote: Any lessor or his agent who receives said rent in advance for the last month of tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held.
rules.summary: Landlords who receive last month's rent in advance must pay the tenant interest at 5% per year or the lesser amount received from the bank where the deposit is held.
rules.penalty: Treble damages equal to three times the amount of interest owed plus court costs and reasonable attorney's fees if interest not paid within 30 days of termination
